picks.headline: Vulnerabilities in World Models Trigger Unintended Command Execution in Agents
picks.why: Adversaries can manipulate agent world-state predictions with up to a 95% success rate to induce unauthorized command execution and financial transactions.
picks.title: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems

picks.headline: China Implements Split-Knowledge Binding for National Agent Identity Layer
picks.why: The deployed framework enforces legal accountability for autonomous AI agents while preserving business-layer identity anonymity.
picks.title: Accountable yet Anonymous AI Agents - Split-Knowledge Binding in National Agent-Identity Layer in China

picks.headline: X-Stage Pipeline Overlap Delivers 1.62x Speedup in DiT Inference
picks.why: Exploiting post-issue GPU gaps for communication-computation overlap bypasses latency bottlenecks in multi-GPU Diffusion Transformer serving.
picks.title: X-Stage: An Overlooked Pipeline Stage for Communication-Computation Overlap in DiT Inference

picks.headline: DeepSeek-V2 Latent Attention Mechanistically Separates Content from Position
picks.why: Uncovering how Multi-head Latent Attention achieves an 81% KV-cache reduction provides actionable principles for custom attention bottleneck engineering.
picks.title: Through the Bottleneck: How Multi-head Latent Attention Separates Content from Position in Language Models

picks.headline: Impossibility Proof Exposes Tradeoff in Outcome-Reward Policy Optimization
picks.why: Mathematical proof shows no length-weighting scheme in GRPO can achieve both gradient unbiasedness and length invariance, defining theoretical limits for post-training RL.
picks.title: On the Impossibility of Unbiased and Length-Invariant Policy Optimization with Outcome Rewards

papers.headline: In-Context Learning Structurally Matches REINFORCE Policy Gradient Optimization
papers.why: This work proves score-conditioned in-context learning structurally performs implicit policy gradient updates, grounding prompt-based adaptation in formal RL theory.
papers.title: In-Context Learning as Implicit Policy Gradient

papers.headline: LARA Injects Low-Rank Corrections Directly into Frozen Residual Streams
papers.why: Rather than updating parameter weight matrices like LoRA, LARA operates purely on residual stream activations to allow modular and composable alignment.
papers.title: LARA: Lightweight Adapters in the Residual Stream for Composable Adaptation and Alignment

papers.headline: Frontier LLMs Suffer Exception Chain Collapse in Nested Rule Evaluation
papers.why: Identifies a critical reliability failure where model accuracy silently degrades during complex rule evaluations, offering a neuro-symbolic mitigation.
papers.title: Confidently Wrong: Exception Chain Collapse in Frontier LLM Rule Evaluation
